blind.description: An ornate gothic stone archway or gateway. On the right is a tall rectangular pillar with gothic pointed-arch tracery recesses, an hourglass relief carving in the front niche, and a carved black raven/crow perched on the capital. A curved arch extends from the pillar down to a shorter square pedestal base on the left. The top and outer face of the arch are sculpted with layered black feathers resembling a bird's wing, while the underside consists of pale beige stone framing. The reverse side features carved feather motifs transitioning between dark and light stone. Materials are aged pale sandstone/limestone masonry and textured charcoal/black feathers. The structure stands directly on the floor via the two column bases with flat undersides and no extra plinth or ground slab. No flames or glowing elements.
blind.from_above: From directly overhead, it appears as an elongated asymmetric span connecting the black perched raven (head, beak, and folded wings visible on the right pillar) to the flat rectangular top of the shorter left pedestal, linked by the dark feathered arch that flares slightly outward to the bottom-left.
